question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Another**" is appropriate here because it introduces an additional aspect without repeating the same idea.
 
• The phrase** "another important aspect" **fits well in the context of listing multiple **features of Romantic poetry.**
 
• Other options like "**Farther**", "**Additional**," and "**Mostly**" do not fit as naturally in this sentence.
 
• Hence, the correct word for fill in the blanks no. 4 is **'another.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Farther (दूर):** Generally used to indicate physical distance, which does not fit in the context of discussing an aspect of poetry.
 
• **Additional (अतिरिक्त): **Though close in meaning, it does not flow as naturally as "another" in this particular context.
 
• **Mostly (अधिकतर):** Indicates the majority of instances, which is not applicable to this context.
